key.name: theme
key.description: Whether the app follows the desktop's colour scheme or overrides it.

key.name: reading-width-limited
key.description: Whether a document's text is held to a comfortable measure rather than filling the window.

key.name: reading-width
key.description: The measure a document's text is held to, in rem — multiples of the document's base font size.

key.name: outline
key.description: Whether a document's headings are listed beside it. F9 shows or hides the outline in one window without changing this.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: How wide the outline sits beside the document, in pixels — where the reader last dragged the divider. Window state rather than a preference: it is chosen by direct manipulation and has no row in the preferences dialog (ux_decisions.md, issue #27).

key.name: window-width
key.description: How wide a window opens, in pixels — the size the reader last left one at. Window state rather than a preference: it is chosen by dragging the window itself and has no row in the preferences dialog (issue #30).

key.name: window-height
key.description: How tall a window opens, in pixels — the size the reader last left one at. Window state, like the width beside it.

key.name: is-maximized
key.description: Whether a window opens filling the screen, because that is how the reader last left one. Window state, like the size beside it.

key.name: remember-position
key.description: Whether a document opens where the reader last left it. With this off nothing is written down and nothing is restored; places already written down are kept.

key.name: autosave
key.description: Whether edits are written back to the file without being asked for.

key.name: autosave-delay
key.description: How long after the last edit an automatic save happens, in seconds.

key.name: spellcheck
key.description: Whether misspelled words are marked in the editor. Reading is never affected.

key.name: engine
key.description: The parser new documents are rendered with, named by its engine id.

key.name: disabled-plugins
key.description: The ids of the rendering plugins the reader has switched off. A plugin is on unless it is named here, so a newly added one arrives enabled.
